summary: The recall of Walgreens Lubricant Eye Drops (lots 3166, 3172, 3173, 3175‑3178, 3180, 3188, 3202‑3203, 3205, 3209‑3210, 3246‑3250, 3252‑3253, 3261‑3264, 3281) due to lack of assurance of sterility has been reported only by the U.S. FDA and related U.S. news outlets. No alerts from other national regulators, WHO, or regional agencies were found in the searched sources. Therefore, the recall appears to be limited to the United States at this time.
